Claim: PM loop round 14 · `domain:cli` seat 2 · p1 · claimed under exception 2 (filer-labelled; the lane fits the table, and the body carries the filing gate's three answers: gate ③, objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2207) · 2026-10-20T19:30Z
Session: `session_01LmjU2x1faLZ39DVTFyVca6`
Account: `os-justin` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; always the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-24944-export-lookup-name-field`
Worktree: `objectstack-issue-24944`
Domain: `domain:cli`
Seat: `domain:cli#2` (seat post #22648)
File surface (read on `origin/main` `693352e4c`; line numbers move; stop on a breach and explain it in the report):
- `packages/rest/src/export-format.ts`. `displayFromRecord` (about `:336`) uses the lookup field's own `displayField`, then `NAME_KEY_FALLBACKS` (about `:107`), and never the target object's `nameField`. The cell names the target record by the target object's declared title field, the rule `packages/objectql/src/record-title.ts` `titleFieldOf` already states (`nameField ?? displayNameField`). The key list stays only as a fallback for an object that declares neither.
- The export route that composes the field meta (`packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`, about `:1227`) as far as it must hand the target object's title field to the formatter.
- Measure first: how the export route can read the target object's schema and the engine's title rule without a second copy of it. `@objectstack/rest` does not depend on `@objectstack/objectql` today. If the only way is a new package dependency, or an edit in `packages/core` (`import-field-meta.ts`) or `packages/objectql`, stop and report. Those are the engine lane's.
- ⛔ Hold-offs:
  - #24945 (the boolean cells' 是 / 否 in the same file), which goes next, serially;
  - the console (objectui);
  - `packages/core/**`, `packages/objectql/**`, `packages/spec/**`.
- One `@objectstack/rest` changeset at `patch`.
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default tier` (`dispatch-gates.mjs --tier`: "no path-derived mandate")
Clause-②: no
Basis for the Clause-② line: a lookup cell's value in the export follows the target object's declared title field. No key, accept set or payload shape moves.
Responsibility: this lane's REST door (`GET /api/v1/data/:object/export`). No platform path covers it. It reaches every list export of a lookup whose target object has no literal `name` column (HotCRM's contacts export as their job title).
Thread-read: none
Serial constraints cleared:
- No open PR touches `export-format.ts`, `data-action-routes.ts` or `record-title.ts`. All 14 open PRs were read in this act.
- This seat's other card in flight, #24809 (PR #24873, the CORS doors), is disjoint. #24945 (same file) waits behind this card.
